notes.title: Twixel has been released!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26554813/ba23bd4f5bb2853a0c7f36d0a419a5e1614d16f9.png[/img]

Following months of hard work taking advantage of lots of the features available on the Steam platform, Twixel has finally been released!

Thank you to all my friends and family that have given me support in this time!

Twixel will continue to be updated with little features throughout the next few months until I'm satisfied it has all the features I originally intended.

It's also my Birthday! So as a celebration of Twixel's release and my Birthday I've been given the attached whiskey.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26554813/9c0689af6e11752a6fd3fc562663937e0b27acf0.jpg[/img]

I hope you all enjoy the game, and by all means post any feedback in the forums, I'll be making sure to read them thoroughly.
